text_001: About Shobon Mahmud | Growth Partner & SEO Specialist.
text_002: Meet Shobon Mahmud: four years of SEO, content, social media and funnel experience, leading a growth team for local businesses, SaaS and service brands.
text_015: A ranking is only worth something if the people it brings can become customers. I start from revenue goals and work back to keywords.
text_017: Search Console, crawls, server logs and the SERP itself settle most debates. I'd rather test than guess.
text_019: Most sites don't need 200 fixes. They need the right ten, done properly, in the right order.
text_021: Nobody controls Google. I promise clear thinking, honest reporting and work that compounds — not #1 rankings.
text_023: Plain-language updates. You always know what's being done, why, and what changed.
text_024: A team built around your priorities
text_025: I lead the strategy and work with my team on research, content and implementation. We can collaborate with your existing marketing, design and development teams, or bring coordinated support to the areas you need.
text_027: Written updates and recorded walkthroughs, with calls when they're genuinely useful.
text_029: Reporting built around traffic quality, leads and revenue — not vanity metrics.
text_031: I'm Shobon — an SEO specialist focused on turning search into sustainable growth.
text_032: My SEO approach covers SaaS, legal tech, health tech, logistics, design, e-commerce, technology and local markets. The industries are different; the question underneath is always the same: how does search turn into customers for this business?
text_033: That question is why I work across the whole SEO stack — technical foundations, content, authority, local and international search — rather than treating any one of them as the answer.
text_038: Four years connecting search with business growth
text_039: Over the last four years, I have worked across SEO, social media growth, content writing and funnel strategy. SEO is my core skill: understanding what people search for, building pages that answer that intent, and making it easier for the right visitor to take the next step.
text_040: Together with my team, I have helped local businesses, home service providers, financial services, law firms, healthcare businesses and SaaS brands grow their online presence. Our experience also includes product design companies, brand design agencies and one-to-one personal portfolio growth.
text_041: That work has contributed to substantial business growth for the clients we support. My approach connects organic visibility with useful content, clear offers and a considered customer journey. The goal is a stronger business, with progress tracked through qualified enquiries, conversions and the opportunities that matter to each client.
text_042: SEO at the centre. Growth across the journey.
text_046: A practical SEO and digital growth skill set
text_050: A clear process, from strategy to delivery
text_051: Space to share the person behind the strategy.
channels_title: Search brings people in. The whole journey helps them convert.
channels_body: I bring SEO, content marketing, social media and funnel planning together around one business goal. Each channel has a role: reaching the right audience, building confidence and helping interested visitors become customers.
channel_1_body: Technical SEO, keyword research, on-page optimisation, internal linking and authority building create a stronger foundation for sustainable organic traffic.
channel_2_body: Search-led articles, service pages, landing pages and content briefs answer real questions, demonstrate expertise and support different stages of the buying journey.
channel_3_body: Audience research, content planning and consistent messaging help turn social attention into brand familiarity and useful visits to your website.
channel_4_body: I organise the path from discovery to enquiry: relevant landing pages, clear offers, trust signals and calls to action that fit the visitor’s intent.
channel_5_body: Local SEO, Google Business Profile optimisation, service-area content and location pages help nearby customers discover a business and get in touch.
channel_6_body: Search Console, analytics and conversion tracking help connect channel activity with qualified traffic, enquiries and business outcomes, then guide the next round of work.
industries_title: Different markets. A strategy shaped around each buyer.
industries_body: My team and I adapt the research, content and conversion journey to the business. A homeowner choosing a contractor, a founder evaluating software and a client searching for a lawyer need different information before they act.
industry_1_body: Local SEO for home service providers connects service-area visibility, Google Maps discovery and clear service pages with calls and booking enquiries.
industry_2_body: Financial SEO and content strategy make complex services easier to understand, with careful attention to accuracy, trust and the questions clients ask before contacting a provider.
industry_3_body: Law firm SEO connects practice-area pages, local search and informative legal content with people looking for relevant professional support.
industry_4_body: Healthcare SEO focuses on understandable service information, local discovery and a clear route to enquiries, with content reviewed by appropriate subject experts.
industry_5_body: SaaS SEO connects problem-aware content, use cases, comparisons and product pages with the journey towards a demo, trial or sales conversation.
industry_6_body: SEO for product design companies and branding agencies brings service positioning, portfolio case studies and founder-focused content together to attract better-fit enquiries.
industry_7_body: One-to-one personal portfolio growth combines positioning, project storytelling, search visibility and social content to help individuals reach relevant clients and opportunities.
team_title: Your SEO partner, backed by a coordinated growth team.
team_body: I stay close to the strategy while my team supports the work needed to deliver it. We connect SEO research, content writing and funnel planning so the business has a shared direction rather than disconnected channel activity.
team_detail: For businesses looking for an SEO agency team or a digital growth partner, our working model combines direct collaboration with me and coordinated team delivery. We define priorities, share implementation briefs and review what is changing against the goals we agreed.
gallery_title: The people and work behind the growth
gallery_body: A closer look at our team, working sessions and life behind the projects.
cta_mid_title: Bring your search, content and funnel into one plan.
cta_mid_body: Tell me about your business, website and growth priorities. We can identify the biggest gaps and the right starting point for your team.
cta_final_title: Build your next stage of growth with an SEO-led team.
cta_final_body: Whether you need local visibility, stronger content or a better path from traffic to enquiries, let’s map out a practical plan for your business.
